A redesigned Network Map, a Traffic Map that actually draws its traffic, real on/off switches, a modern dashboard and a full layout audit of every page.

### Network Map

- **Tree layout**: Internet → firewall → a trunk down the left with one branch per network; each network is a full-width row and its devices fill it **left to right**
- **"String" data flow**: streaks of light run along every link — download one way, upload the other — at a speed that follows the traffic. The trunk carries the sum of the networks below it, so it thins out towards the end
- **Live dot next to each device's name** (e.g. *Kitchen-CCTV ●*), rippling while the device is busy
- Stats cards no longer cut off their text on phones

### Traffic Map

- **Fixed: no arcs were drawn.** A check that dims arcs while you hover a country compared `null` with `false`, so with nothing hovered neither the arcs nor the moving dots were painted
- **Streaks of light** along the arcs instead of dots, with a pulse at each destination and a slow "live" ring on your firewall
- **Smooth refreshes**: speeds glide to the new rate, arcs fade in and out, new streaks start at the source and old ones finish their trip — nothing jumps when data arrives
- **Live throughput sparklines** in the Download and Upload cards, scrolling continuously
- The Top 20 table is updated in place: rows keep their place, slide to a new rank and only changed cells are touched (it was rebuilt every 3 seconds)
- Lighter on the CPU: the curve is sampled once per arc and a frame is a handful of batched strokes; on a slow machine the animation drops to a steady 30 fps instead of stuttering, and gives scrolling priority
- **Behind CGNAT** (no public address on the firewall) your country now comes from the time zone in *System → Settings → General*, so the arcs still have a starting point

### Dashboard

- Slim gauges with rounded ends and larger centre text
- Ring charts (Interface Statistics, Firewall) with gaps, rounded segments and dot legends; long Firewall rule names move the legend under the chart instead of being cut off
- Thin, smooth traffic lines with a light wash instead of a 50 % fill; borderless axes
- A modern series palette replaces tableau colours; thermal bars use the theme's ok / warning / critical colours
- Meter bars (progress) with a soft sheen and an animated fill; the Firewall → Aliases table-entries meter no longer collapses to a sliver

### Switches

- The *advanced mode* / *full help* toggles, log filters and the grid *Enabled* columns are proper **36 × 20 switches** (they were 18 × 16 glyphs)
- **Every on/off setting** in MVC forms and edit dialogs is a switch too, like UniFi OS; row selectors, lists and classic pages keep checkboxes
- No white ring around a switch after clicking it (focus ring only for keyboard use)

### Menu

- **Keep all sections open**: a new option in the appearance menu (sun/moon button). Every menu section stays open; clicking a header folds only that section
- Long menu labels wrap instead of being cut off ("Dnsmasq DNS & DHCP")

### Layout audit

Every one of the 117 MVC pages was rendered and checked at 1440, 1024 and 390 px wide (a new `tests/harness/audit_layout.py`), with their edit dialogs opened:

- Phones: settings forms and edit dialogs stack label above field (they kept three columns and cut labels to "Interfac"); on/off settings put the label and its switch on one line
- Phones: pages no longer scroll sideways by 8 px; wide tables scroll inside their card
- Plain tables let long values (timestamps, addresses) wrap, so they no longer push the page sideways at 1024 px (Reporting → Traffic → Top talkers)
- Unbound DNS → Overview: the Total / Resolved / Blocked / Blocklist counters are stat cards (two per row on phones) instead of squeezed pills, without the empty 80 px above them
- Column headings are sentence case and wrap (no more "PROTOCO…"), cells wrap instead of "Update and reload firewall al…"
- Toolbar selects size to their content; the caret no longer eats the text (bootstrap-select reserved its space twice)
- Firewall → Log Files → Live View: the filter bar wraps instead of overflowing at 1024 px
- "Clear All / Select All" under multi-selects are quiet links instead of two red ones

### Update

```sh
fetch -o - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ox1d3x3/unisense/main/install.sh | sh
```

Then reload the page in your browser (Ctrl+F5) to pick up the new styles.
